mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated unemployment rates exceeding 7.0% signal deteriorating labor market conditions and reduced consumer spending, depressing corporate earnings expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 7.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate weakening consumer demand, signaling reduced corporate revenue growth and triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-crisis recovery phase, the Federal Funds rate at or near the zero lower bound signals aggressive monetary policy support for equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is at or below 0.25%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production reflects expanding manufacturing output and economic activity, boosting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI index increase exceeding 0.2% signals rising inflationary pressures, prompting expectations of tighter monetary policy and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL monthly change exceeds 0.2%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime, a decline in non-farm payrolls signals worsening labor market conditions and reduced consumer spending, depressing corporate earnings and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS declines in high unemployment (UNRATE > 7.0%), or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a recessionary phase, a combination of falling federal funds rates and rising unemployment signals deepening economic distress, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
